verdict.rationale: Devin sessions run in their own cloud VM with shell, browser and repo access, booting into a configured known-good environment. The CLI offers a `--sandbox` flag that enforces OS-level isolation of writable paths and can restrict network traffic. Together these give the agent an isolated place to build and test away from the user's live systems. missing for 10: explicit documentation on keeping production data out of sandboxes (e.g. test/staging databases or seeded fixtures, especially since VPN access can reach internal databases), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation.
